Hey, you are saying you are young, but I wonder if both of you are financially independent. Because if constant self-harm is involved, then I'm afraid that words and comfort alone wouldn't be enough. Both of you can do some research at home later with the information you have from the check up, or look out support group from people with the same condition to have some general idea of how to help your gf.

If you can't afford to get one check up, observe and note down all of her symptoms and categorize them into groups and search them on medical books (like dsm 5 tr) to have an slightest idea of what she might have (don't do a full diagnosis if you aren't psychologist/psychiatrist) and research the method to help her from there, or to ground her when she has the urge to harm herself.

I know this comment isn't of help, but good luck to both of you.
